text:
Jordan (SRE): Heads-up — we're seeing a partial degradation on the hosted API since ~14:00 UTC. A subset of requests to /v1/generate are returning 503s or timing out after 10s. High error spike on the telemetry dashboard.

OpsBot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected on hosted-api-prod (svc-hosted-api). Incident created automatically: INC-2024-042. Pinged oncall.

Anna (oncall): I'm looking. Confirmed increased p95 and p99 latency, errors concentrated on rserve-*-pool nodes. Triage in progress.

Michael D.: FYI I pushed an autoscaler tweak at 13:30 to change scaleUpCooldown from 60s -> 300s to reduce thrash. Could that be related?

Priya S.: Possibly — if scale-up cooldown prevents new nodes during a traffic spike we'll queue and hit request queue limits. Checking scaling events now.

Jordan (SRE): Scaling logs show repeated rejected scale-up due to cooldown window starting at 13:32. CPU on several pods hit 95% and requests started queueing.

Leo (Platform Eng): Reproduced locally with load test. Autoscaler rejected scale because cooldown state persisted after a failed attempt. Looks like a regression introduced in the autoscaler state machine.

Priya S.: Mitigation applied: rolled back autoscaler PR (git revert 7a3f2b) and triggered manual scale to +8 nodes. Commands used:
```
git checkout main
git revert 7a3f2b --no-edit
kubectl -n hosted-api scale deployment hosted-api --replicas=24
```

Anna (oncall): After manual scale we see errors falling, CPU trending down. Starting to reroute new requests to healthy pools and draining affected nodes.

StatusPage Bot: Status update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2024-042 — Partial degradation for hosted API. Customers affected: some PLG customers in us-west-2.

Jordan (SRE): Current status: mitigated — traffic normalized and 5xx rate back to baseline. We'll monitor for 2 hours. Root cause preliminary: autoscaler cooldown state regression prevented scale-ups under rapid spike.

Michael D.: Sorry — my change introduced a missed state transition. Will own the postmortem and follow-up fix.

Priya S.: Next steps: 1) postmortem (Jordan + Michael + Priya), 2) add canary for autoscaler state transitions, 3) improve alerting to detect sustained cooldown window during traffic spikes.

Anna (oncall): Customer comms draft in the incident doc, please review: https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2024-042/comms-draft.md @everyone

Jordan (SRE): Marking incident as resolved for now — keeping channel open for monitoring. If anyone sees regression, ping @oncall immediately. :white_check_mark:
